masking: One fixed per-cell mask, SeedSequence20261021/rawrow/250; hide floor25pct of originally selected expressed tokens, min1; no resampling/refilling. Pad hidden slots; recompute binning and visible library totals after excluding hidden gene counts. Same mask across arms/seeds. Gene presence/selected token identities remain known from original expressed-token sampling.
backbone: Frozen scGPT same512token final-layer signed masked mean; float32 extraction MPS; no scGPT gradients or finetuning.
init: A/C same fold/seed historical MSE warmup SAE checkpoint as clean-MSE continuation. Width2048/rawTopK32, signed selected values, fixed clean TRAIN mean, decoder column unit norms. A_dense 512->2048 GELU->512 residual MLP, zero final-layer weights/identity init; similar parameter count but different init/activation, descriptive capacity control.
A_loss: MSE(SAE(masked_h),stopgrad(clean_h)) / cleanTRAIN centered mean square; no clean loss mixing.
C_loss: Masked-positive-token logCP10k expression reconstruction through512D SAE output only; gene-wise TRAIN positive-expression mean/std(floor0.1) standardized MSE.2048 genes selected by TRAIN-only logCP10k variance, vocabulary matched, >=20 positive TRAIN cells. No embedding reconstruction loss, no direct token path to gene head.
C_head: Linear512->2048, receives (SAEout-cleanTRAINmean)/cleanTRAINstd fixed; trainable with SAE. Same readout bottleneck at evaluation; no classifier gradients.
A_dense_loss: Same A target, input, batch indices, steps, optimizer and LR schedule; residual dense initialization differs from SAE warmup.
optimizer: Adam reset, no weight decay; lr cosine3e-4->1e-5; paired inherited TRAIN minibatches across all newarms; fixed finalstep1000, no checkpoint selection.
downstream_selection: TRAIN-clean transformed features; channel scaling fitTRAIN only; same11 Ridge alpha1e-4..1e6 selected on clean VALID fixed8class MacroF1, ascending-alpha ties; no refit or fallback. Same fitted readout predicts clean and masked TEST.
primary: Clean TEST Ridge MacroF1 change vs original_h and clean_mse
Masked TEST Ridge MacroF1 and clean-minus-masked degradation using same clean-fit readout
secondary: 15NN clean TRAIN reference / clean or masked TEST query; common original TRAIN mean centered cosine
Within-type B/CD14 IFN fixedalpha10 TRAIN-clean fitted; all3 technical covariate variants; minTRAIN100/minTEST30
A normalized embedding reconstruction error on clean/masked TEST; C raw log-expression masked-token MAE and normalized MSE vs TRAIN gene-mean predictor
Teacher geometry fidelity metrics on both views
split: Same6 Kang rotations4TRAIN/1VALID/1TEST separately percondition; PBMC2direction batchholdout with fixed source20pctVALID. Same as sealed prior evaluations.
budget: One masked view percell. Clean+masked evaluations separate. No TEST-based model/method/seed selection or adaptive training length.
statistics: Average3seeds within heldout group, then equal group average; Kang donors6 eachcondition not independentcohorts; PBMC2batches not donors; historical exploratory data.
scope: Tests A/C dataset-specific frozen-backbone refinement, not new observed biological information, SAE concept causality or guaranteed SAE-specific benefit. C predicts positive selected tokens only; normalization targets use fullRNA but hidden values excluded from input bins verified via invariance test. IFN sameRNA proxy. DenseA not matched-initialization proof.
review: Independent experiment-audit and result-to-claim before broad claims
